accel_movement_data_fifo_enabled.label: accelerometer movement FIFO enabled
accel_movement_data_fifo_enabled.description: Enable the accelerometer movement data FIFO.

air_quality_enabled.label: air quality sensor enabled
air_quality_enabled.description: Enable the air quality sensors (BME690 and BMV080). Only available on rangeredge boards running the air quality firmware.

air_quality_interval.label: air quality interval
air_quality_interval.description: Seconds between checks for new air quality data. The sensors themselves sample on a fixed 5-minute duty cycle; each check packs available data into a message for the enabled recipients.

app_eui.label: app EUI (join EUI)
app_eui.description: The app ID used when joining the network.

app_key.label: app key
app_key.description: The key used to join the network.

ble_scan_aggregated_interval.label: BLE scan aggregated interval
ble_scan_aggregated_interval.description: Controls how often aggregated BLE scan results are produced.

ble_scan_filter.label: BLE scan filter
ble_scan_filter.description: Filtering applied to scanned data before storing or sending.

ble_scan_manufacturer_id.label: BLE scan manufacturer ID
ble_scan_manufacturer_id.description: Manufacturer ID used for filtering; hex value (e.g., 0x0A61).

ble_scan_report_zero_connections_found.label: BLE scan report empty results
ble_scan_report_zero_connections_found.description: Send a report (empty message) even when the Bluetooth scan found nothing.

check_error_interval.label: error check interval
check_error_interval.description: Seconds between checks for error conditions.

cmdq_enabled.label: CMDQ enabled
cmdq_enabled.description: Enable the CMDQ module. Disabling it while a scan is running stops the scan.

cmdq_on_no_detection_wait_duration.label: CMDQ wait after failed long scan
cmdq_on_no_detection_wait_duration.description: Seconds to wait after a LONG scan fails before trying again.
cmdq_on_no_detection_wait_duration.display_name: CMDQ wait after failed long scan

cmdq_report_zero_messages_to_be_sent.label: CMDQ report when nothing detected
cmdq_report_zero_messages_to_be_sent.description: Send an empty report when no CMDQ detection was made between two reporting intervals.

cmdq_reporting_interval.label: CMDQ reporting interval
cmdq_reporting_interval.description: Seconds between composing/sending CMDQ detections to other queues.

cmdq_scan_duration.label: CMDQ short scan duration
cmdq_scan_duration.description: Milliseconds spent actively scanning during a SHORT scan.

cmdq_search_interval.label: CMDQ search interval
cmdq_search_interval.description: Seconds between scans. For IMMEDIATE/LONG scans this is the active scan duration; set near the device advertisement interval.

cmdq_searched_mac_address.label: CMDQ searched MAC address
cmdq_searched_mac_address.description: Bluetooth MAC address (hex byte array) of the device to search for.

cold_fix_retry.label: cold fix retries
cold_fix_retry.description: Extra cold fix attempts after the first failed one, one per interval. After the last unsuccessful attempt the GPS module is turned off.

cold_fix_timeout.label: cold fix timeout
cold_fix_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for one cold fix attempt.

device_eui.label: device EUI
device_eui.description: The unique ID for this device.

device_name.label: device name
device_name.description: Device name shown in Bluetooth scans (up to 8 characters).

device_pin.label: Bluetooth PIN
device_pin.description: Four-digit PIN required to connect over Bluetooth. 0000 means no PIN is checked.

enable_motion_trig_gps.label: motion-triggered GPS enabled
enable_motion_trig_gps.description: Enables motion-triggered GPS. When enabled, motion is checked using the accelerometer and motion_ths threshold. This feature supports two behaviors: the default skip-fix mode based on ublox_send_interval, and an optional trigger-window mode based on gps_triggered_interval plus gps_motion_triggered_min_num_of_triggers_per_interval.

external_switch_counter_enabled.label: external switch counter enabled
external_switch_counter_enabled.description: Toggle between switch activity detection and impulse counter. When enabled, the device counts transitions from inactivity to activity (respecting debounce) within the reporting interval.

external_switch_detection_enabled.label: external switch detection enabled
external_switch_detection_enabled.description: Turns on external switch detection. Must not be enabled at the same time as fence_enabled; firmware will disable external switch functionality if both are enabled.

external_switch_detection_gpio_pin_power.label: external switch GPIO pin power
external_switch_detection_gpio_pin_power.description: Use the GPIO output of the fence port to enable (power) the external switch.

external_switch_detection_reporting_inte.label: external switch reporting interval
external_switch_detection_reporting_inte.description: Reporting interval for periodic status reports over LoRa. 0 disables periodic reports; activity/inactivity transitions still send immediately.

external_switch_detection_trigger_deboun.label: external switch debounce (ms)
external_switch_detection_trigger_deboun.description: Debounce time in ms after a state change; additional changes are ignored during this period. After debounce, the input is re-read to confirm. 0 disables debouncing (not recommended for floating or mismatched pulls).

external_switch_detection_trigger_type.label: external switch trigger type
external_switch_detection_trigger_type.description: Controls how the device interprets AN (GPIO input) activity.

external_switch_input_pull.label: external switch input pull
external_switch_input_pull.description: Set the pull of the AN (GPIO input) line. If the external switch already provides a pull, setting this incorrectly can increase power consumption or cause undefined behavior.

external_switch_minimal_report_duration_.label: external switch minimal report duration (ms)
external_switch_minimal_report_duration_.description: Minimum activity duration required before sending a report to avoid flooding the LoRa queue with short detections.

external_switch_send_inactivity_report.label: external switch inactivity report
external_switch_send_inactivity_report.description: When enabled, send an inactivity report when external_switch_detection_reporting_interval expires.

fence_interval.label: fence measurement interval
fence_interval.description: Seconds between fence measurements. 0 disables measurements.

fence_led_blink.label: fence LED blink
fence_led_blink.description: Blink the LED during fence measurements.

fence_mv_scaling_factor.label: fence mV scaling factor
fence_mv_scaling_factor.description: Scaling factor applied to measured mV. Default 10000 (1000 mV -> 10 kV).

flash_status_interval.label: flash status interval
flash_status_interval.description: Seconds between flash status messages (port 14: percentage used and number of stored messages). 0 means the message is not sent or stored.

flash_store_flag.label: messages stored in flash
flash_store_flag.description: Which message types are stored in the flash log. Each bit is a port number: bit 1 = port 1, bit 2 = port 2, and so on.

gnss_constellation_to_use.label: GNSS constellation
gnss_constellation_to_use.description: GNSS constellation used by the LR GNSS scan.

gps_backoff_factor.label: GPS backoff factor
gps_backoff_factor.description: Delay applied to the next GNSS fix after an unsuccessful fix attempt.

gps_init_lat.label: initial latitude
gps_init_lat.description: Initial latitude in decimal degrees. Raw value is degrees * 1e7 (int32).

gps_init_lon.label: initial longitude
gps_init_lon.description: Initial longitude in decimal degrees. Raw value is degrees * 1e7 (int32).

gps_motion_triggered_min_num_of_triggers.label: motion triggers needed per window
gps_motion_triggered_min_num_of_triggers.description: Used by motion-triggered GPS window mode. A fresh GPS fix is performed when this many motion events are detected within gps_triggered_interval seconds. Default is 5. Set this to 0, or set gps_triggered_interval to 0, to disable window mode and fall back to the default skip-fix behavior. Motion events are still counted during the fixed 30-second failsafe between GPS fixes, but no new fix is started during that failsafe.

gps_open_sky_detection_avg_rssi_threshol.label: open sky detection avg rssi threshold dbm
gps_open_sky_detection_avg_rssi_threshol.description: Average RSSI threshold (dBm). Must be exceeded along with the max RSSI threshold to trigger a GPS fix.
gps_open_sky_detection_avg_rssi_threshol.display_name: open sky detection avg rssi threshold dbm

gps_open_sky_detection_bitmask.label: open sky detection bitmask
gps_open_sky_detection_bitmask.description: Bitmask for open sky scan bands. Bit 7 enables the feature; bits 6–0 select bands 100–200, 400–500, 800–1000, 1200–1400, 1500–1600, 1800–2100, 2400–2500 MHz.

gps_open_sky_detection_max_rssi_threshol.label: open sky detection max rssi threshold dbm
gps_open_sky_detection_max_rssi_threshol.description: Max RSSI threshold (dBm). Must be exceeded along with the average RSSI threshold to trigger a GPS fix.
gps_open_sky_detection_max_rssi_threshol.display_name: open sky detection max rssi threshold dbm

gps_resend_interval.label: last position resend interval
gps_resend_interval.description: Controls how often the device sends the last known GNSS position.

gps_skipped_triggered_interval.label: max skipped fix intervals
gps_skipped_triggered_interval.description: In default motion-triggered GPS mode, this sets how many consecutive ublox_send_interval periods may be skipped when no motion is detected before the device performs a fresh GPS fix anyway. Set to 0 to perform a fix on every ublox_send_interval.

gps_triggered_interval.label: motion trigger window
gps_triggered_interval.description: Used by motion-triggered GPS window mode. Each detected motion event temporarily increases an internal trigger counter for this many seconds. When the counter reaches gps_motion_triggered_min_num_of_triggers_per_interval, the device performs a fresh GPS fix independently of ublox_send_interval. Default is 60 seconds. Set this to 0, or set gps_motion_triggered_min_num_of_triggers_per_interval to 0, to disable window mode and use the default skip-fix behavior.

hot_fix_retry.label: hot fix retries
hot_fix_retry.description: Extra hot fix attempts after the first failed one, one per interval. After the last unsuccessful one the next fix is cold.

hot_fix_timeout.label: hot fix timeout
hot_fix_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for one hot fix attempt.

lp0_app_key.label: LP0 app key
lp0_app_key.description: AppSKey (16 bytes) used to encode LP0 messages.

lp0_communication_params.label: LP0 communication parameters
lp0_communication_params.description: LP0 modulation parameters (byte array). See the firmware LP0 documentation for the byte layout.

lp0_dev_addr.label: LP0 device address
lp0_dev_addr.description: Device address (4 bytes) used to encode LP0 messages.

lp0_network_key.label: LP0 network key
lp0_network_key.description: NwkSKey (16 bytes) used to encode LP0 messages.

lp0_node_params.label: LP0 node parameters
lp0_node_params.description: LP0 node configuration (byte array). See the firmware LP0 documentation for the byte layout.

lp0_master_key.label: LP0 cluster master key
lp0_master_key.description: 16-byte key shared by every tracker and offload station in one LP0 cluster. Devices with different master keys cannot discover each other. The all-zero default is accepted but public; use one random key per cluster. Firmware 8.2 (beta).

lp0_signal_checks.label: LP0 signal checks
lp0_signal_checks.description: Six bytes: master switch, CAD veto, minimum RSSI check, minimum RSSI magnitude (100 = -100 dBm), background margin check, minimum margin in dB. Default 1 1 1 100 0 20: the background margin check is off by default since the 2026-11-03 schema, its threshold stays stored at 20 dB. A change applies to the next offload visit. Firmware 8.2 (beta).

lp0_focus_offloading.label: LP0 focus on offloading
lp0_focus_offloading.description: When on, routine GPS fixes, scans and scheduled radio sends wait while an offload is prepared and running. Enable it on both the tracker and the station for a dedicated offload session. Firmware 8.2 (beta).

lp0_gps_before_start.label: LP0 GPS fix before offloading
lp0_gps_before_start.description: Take a u-blox GPS fix before an LP0 offload session starts so the device's clock is set from the receiver. Meant for offload stations, which timestamp the records they store on the SD card. Off by default. Firmware 8.2 (beta).

lr_enabled.label: LoRaWAN enabled
lr_enabled.description: Master switch for the LoRaWAN stack, on by default. Firmware 8.2 (beta); the firmware documentation does not describe the effect of switching it off yet, so leave it on unless the firmware team asks otherwise.

ublox_require_time.label: GPS fix requires valid time
ublox_require_time.description: Firmware 8.2 (beta). Not yet described in the firmware documentation; leave it at the default (off) unless the firmware team asks for it.

lp0_discovery_retry_count.label: LP0 discovery retries
lp0_discovery_retry_count.description: Extra automatic discovery attempts a tracker may make within one discovery interval after a failed attempt, 0 to 255. 0 (the default) means one attempt per interval; a failed attempt then waits for the next interval. Retries use a short randomised delay. Firmware 8.2 (beta).

lp0_statistics_interval.label: LP0 station statistics interval
lp0_statistics_interval.description: How often an offload station generates its statistics report (port 23). 0 disables it; enabled values must be 60 to 604800 seconds. Only the station role generates reports; port 23 must also be ticked in the send or store flags. Firmware 8.2 (beta).

lp0_send_flag.label: LP0 messages sent
lp0_send_flag.description: Which message types are sent over LP0. Each bit is a port number: bit 1 = port 1, bit 2 = port 2, and so on.

lr_adr.label: data rate (custom ADR)
lr_adr.description: Data rate (DR0-DR15) used when the adaptive data rate profile is Custom. EU 868 allows DR0-DR7; US 915 allows DR0-DR4 and DR8-DR13.

lr_adr_profile.label: ADR profile
lr_adr_profile.description: Adaptive data rate profile: network controlled (static devices), mobile long range, mobile low power, or custom (uses the data rate setting).

lr_confirm_flag.label: confirmed messages (message types)
lr_confirm_flag.description: Which message types are sent as confirmed LoRaWAN uplinks. Each bit is a port number: bit 1 = port 1.

lr_join_flag.label: join before sending (message types)
lr_join_flag.description: Which message types make the device attempt a join first when it is not joined. Each bit is a port number: bit 1 = port 1.

lr_max_confirm_fail.label: max confirmed send failures
lr_max_confirm_fail.description: Maximum number of failed confirmed LoRaWAN messages.

lr_messaging_retry_count.label: messaging retry count
lr_messaging_retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts for messages sent from the Messenger card.

lr_messaging_retry_interval.label: messaging retry interval
lr_messaging_retry_interval.description: Controls how long the device waits between LR messaging retry attempts.

lr_send_flag.label: messages sent over LoRaWAN
lr_send_flag.description: Which message types are sent over LoRaWAN. Each bit is a port number: bit 1 = port 1, bit 2 = port 2, and so on.

motion_ths.label: motion threshold
motion_ths.description: Accelerometer sensitivity threshold used by motion-triggered GPS to detect movement. Default is 6. Refer to the LIS2DW12 datasheet for the detailed threshold behavior.

outdoor_detection_enabled.label: outdoor detection enabled
outdoor_detection_enabled.description: Enable outdoor detection and disable the standard GPS fix interval. Used to trigger GPS fixes only when the device is likely outside.

outdoor_detection_parameters.label: outdoor detection parameters
outdoor_detection_parameters.description: Weights for outdoor probability: bias (2B), temperature (2B), accelerometer (2B), hour (2B), time-zone offset seconds (4B). Little-endian signed ints, multiply values by 1000 before encoding. Default TZ offset is GMT+2.

outdoor_detection_tau.label: outdoor detection tau
outdoor_detection_tau.description: Probability threshold required to trigger a GPS fix.

rejoin_interval.label: rejoin interval
rejoin_interval.description: How often the device tries to rejoin the network.

rf_open_sky_detection_interval1.label: interval1
rf_open_sky_detection_interval1.description: Primary RF open sky detection interval.

rf_open_sky_detection_interval2.label: interval2
rf_open_sky_detection_interval2.description: Secondary RF open sky detection interval.

s_band_app_key.label: app key
s_band_app_key.description: AppSKey (16 bytes) used to encode S-Band messages.

s_band_dev_adr.label: dev adr
s_band_dev_adr.description: Device address (4 bytes) used to encode S-Band messages.

s_band_network_key.label: network key
s_band_network_key.description: NwkSKey (16 bytes) used to encode S-Band messages.

s_band_rf_frequency_hz.label: S-Band frequency (Hz)
s_band_rf_frequency_hz.description: Frequency in Hz on which S-Band LoRa operates.

s_band_send_interval.label: S-Band send interval
s_band_send_interval.description: Seconds between S-Band sends of the status and short position message. 0 disables S-Band sending.

s_band_send_mode.label: S-Band send mode
s_band_send_mode.description: S-Band send mode: 0 = send without FHSS, 1 = send with FHSS, 2 = both.

sat_send_flag.label: messages sent over satellite
sat_send_flag.description: Which message types are sent over the satellite modem. Each bit is a port number: bit 1 = port 1, bit 2 = port 2, and so on.

satellite_enabled.label: satellite enabled
satellite_enabled.description: Enable satellite support (Iridium modem) when the hardware has one.

satellite_interval1_start.label: satellite day window start (UTC hour)
satellite_interval1_start.description: UTC hour (0-23) when the primary Iridium satellite send interval starts. When satellite_multiple_intervals is enabled, satellite_send_interval is used from this hour until satellite_send_interval2_start.

satellite_max_messages_per_interval.label: max messages per interval
satellite_max_messages_per_interval.description: Maximum number of Iridium satellite messages allowed within each send interval.

satellite_multiple_intervals.label: satellite day/night schedule
satellite_multiple_intervals.description: Enables two UTC-based Iridium satellite send schedules. When disabled, only satellite_send_interval is used. When enabled, satellite_send_interval applies from satellite_interval1_start until satellite_send_interval2_start, and satellite_send_interval2 applies outside that window.

satellite_retry.label: satellite send retries
satellite_retry.description: Number of send attempts per satellite session. The delay between retries is random: 1 to 5 s for the first 3, 5 to 20 s up to the 6th, 20 to 40 s after that.

satellite_send_interval.label: satellite send interval
satellite_send_interval.description: Primary Iridium satellite send interval. When satellite_multiple_intervals is disabled, this is the only interval used. When enabled, this interval applies from satellite_interval1_start until satellite_send_interval2_start (UTC).

satellite_send_interval2.label: satellite night send interval
satellite_send_interval2.description: Secondary Iridium satellite send interval. Only used when satellite_multiple_intervals is enabled. This interval applies from satellite_send_interval2_start until satellite_interval1_start on the next day (UTC).

satellite_send_interval2_start.label: satellite night window start (UTC hour)
satellite_send_interval2_start.description: UTC hour (0-23) when the secondary Iridium satellite send interval starts. When satellite_multiple_intervals is enabled, satellite_send_interval2 is used from this hour until satellite_interval1_start on the next day.

ublox_active_tracking.label: GPS active tracking
ublox_active_tracking.description: Keep the u-blox GNSS receiver on between fixes. When enabled, position reports on port 2 also include course over ground and speed over ground when available. Uses considerably more battery.

ublox_cold_fix_hour_interval.label: cold fix hour interval
ublox_cold_fix_hour_interval.description: Controls how often a cold u-blox fix attempt is allowed, in hours.

ublox_interval1_start.label: GPS day window start (UTC hour)
ublox_interval1_start.description: UTC hour (0-23) when the primary u-blox GNSS fix interval starts. Only used when ublox_multiple_intervals is enabled; ublox_send_interval then applies from this hour until ublox_interval2_start.

ublox_interval2_start.label: GPS night window start (UTC hour)
ublox_interval2_start.description: UTC hour (0-23) when the secondary u-blox GNSS fix interval starts. Only used when ublox_multiple_intervals is enabled; ublox_send_interval_2 then applies from this hour until ublox_interval1_start on the next day.

ublox_leave_on.label: GPS leave on
ublox_leave_on.description: How long, in seconds, the u-blox receiver stays on after a fix completes.

ublox_min_fix_time.label: minimum fix time
ublox_min_fix_time.description: Minimum time, in seconds, the u-blox receiver keeps searching for GNSS satellites in order to perform a fix.

ublox_min_satellites.label: minimum satellites
ublox_min_satellites.description: Minimum number of satellites that must be visible at the check to continue a fix attempt. 0 turns the check off.

ublox_min_satellites_timer.label: minimum satellites check timeout
ublox_min_satellites_timer.description: Seconds into a fix attempt at which the satellite count is checked (firmware default 30). Only used while the minimum satellites check is on.

ublox_multiple_intervals.label: GPS day/night schedule
ublox_multiple_intervals.description: Enables two UTC-based u-blox GNSS fix schedules. When disabled, only ublox_send_interval is used. When enabled, ublox_send_interval applies from ublox_interval1_start until ublox_interval2_start, and ublox_send_interval_2 applies outside that window.

ublox_send_interval.label: GPS fix interval
ublox_send_interval.description: Primary u-blox GNSS fix interval. When ublox_multiple_intervals is disabled, this is the only interval used. When enabled, this interval applies from ublox_interval1_start until ublox_interval2_start (UTC).

ublox_send_interval_2.label: GPS night fix interval
ublox_send_interval_2.description: Secondary u-blox GNSS fix interval. Only used when ublox_multiple_intervals is enabled. This interval applies from ublox_interval2_start until ublox_interval1_start on the next day (UTC).

ublox_switch_interval.label: switch interval
ublox_switch_interval.description: Controls how often the device switches its u-blox operating mode or schedule.

vhf_external_path.label: VHF external path
vhf_external_path.description: Send VHF transmissions over the external VHF antenna connector instead of the on-board LoRaWAN antenna. Only applies to boards with the VHF connector; Rhino Edge Cube, Puck50 and Puck35 have none, so enabling it there changes nothing.

vhf_interval1.label: VHF day interval
vhf_interval1.description: Primary VHF transmit interval. When vhf_multiple_intervals is disabled, this is the only interval used. When enabled, this interval applies from vhf_interval1_start until vhf_interval2_start (UTC).

vhf_interval1_start.label: VHF day window start (UTC hour)
vhf_interval1_start.description: UTC hour (0-23) when the primary VHF interval starts. When vhf_multiple_intervals is enabled, vhf_interval1 is used from this hour until vhf_interval2_start.

vhf_interval2.label: VHF night interval
vhf_interval2.description: Secondary VHF transmit interval. Only used when vhf_multiple_intervals is enabled. This interval applies from vhf_interval2_start until vhf_interval1_start on the next day (UTC).

vhf_interval2_start.label: VHF night window start (UTC hour)
vhf_interval2_start.description: UTC hour (0-23) when the secondary VHF interval starts. When vhf_multiple_intervals is enabled, vhf_interval2 is used from this hour until vhf_interval1_start on the next day.

vhf_multiple_intervals.label: VHF day/night schedule
vhf_multiple_intervals.description: Enables two UTC-based VHF transmit schedules. When disabled, only vhf_interval1 is used. When enabled, vhf_interval1 applies from vhf_interval1_start until vhf_interval2_start, and vhf_interval2 applies outside that window.

vhf_num_of_packets_per_burst.label: VHF packets per burst
vhf_num_of_packets_per_burst.description: Number of VHF beeps (pulses) per burst.

vhf_single_pulse_duration_ms.label: VHF pulse duration (ms)
vhf_single_pulse_duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds of each pulse inside a burst.

vhf_time_between_packets_ms.label: VHF time between packets (ms)
vhf_time_between_packets_ms.description: Time in milliseconds between beeps within a single burst. Only applies when more than one packet is sent per burst.

wifi_scan_aggregated_interval.label: WiFi scan aggregated interval
wifi_scan_aggregated_interval.description: Controls how often aggregated WiFi scan results are produced.

wifi_scan_report_zero_connections_found.label: WiFi scan report empty results
wifi_scan_report_zero_connections_found.description: Send a report (empty message) even when the WiFi scan found nothing.

cmd_aggregated_bt_scan.label: aggregated bt scan
cmd_aggregated_bt_scan.description: Internal: initiate periodic aggregated BT scan between threads.

cmd_almanac_update.label: almanac update
cmd_almanac_update.description: Update almanac in chunks. Send cmd on port 32 with cmd id, length, and 20-byte chunks; header id 128 triggers update if newer.

cmd_bt_disconnect.label: bt disconnect
cmd_bt_disconnect.description: Disconnect a Bluetooth device if connected.

cmd_check_pin.label: check pin
cmd_check_pin.description: Validate PIN code before allowing BT connection. Format: pin_len pin[pin_len].

cmd_clear_nvs.label: clear nvs
cmd_clear_nvs.description: Clear internal storage; resets values to defaults and deletes LoRaWAN keys.

cmd_decouple_collar.label: decouple collar
cmd_decouple_collar.description: CollarEdge: power the decoupling connector for 5 seconds.

cmd_disable_bt_th.label: disable bt th
cmd_disable_bt_th.description: Disable BT thread; BT module will be inactive.

cmd_disable_flash_th.label: disable flash th
cmd_disable_flash_th.description: Disable flash thread; nothing stored to flash.

cmd_flash_clear.label: flash clear
cmd_flash_clear.description: Clear all data from external flash.

cmd_flash_clear_confirmed.label: delete confirmed logs
cmd_flash_clear_confirmed.description: Erase whole flash sectors from the oldest logs onward as long as every record in them was confirmed delivered over the selected medium (or any medium). Stops at the first sector with an unconfirmed record. Replies with cmd_confirm 1 (done) or 0 (busy or failed). Firmware 8.2 (beta).

cmd_offload_start.label: start offload
cmd_offload_start.description: Start a manual transfer of saved records: medium (0 LP0, 1 LoRaWAN, 2 satellite, 3 Bluetooth), selection (0 all, 1 confirmed, 2 unconfirmed over that medium), port (0 all, or 1 to 32). The reply carries the job ID, state and result; a Bluetooth transfer streams the records on port 29 and ends without a further message. Firmware 8.2 (beta).

cmd_offload_cancel.label: cancel offload
cmd_offload_cancel.description: Cancel the current manual or automatic offload: job ID as uint32, or 0 for whatever runs. Firmware 8.2 (beta).

cmd_flash_get_all.label: flash get all
cmd_flash_get_all.description: Get all messages on a port (port=0 for all). Returns messages then msg_cmd_confirm.

cmd_flash_get_from_head.label: flash get from head
cmd_flash_get_from_head.description: Read a specific number of messages from a given port, starting at a chosen message.

cmd_get_lr_satellite_data.label: get lr satellite data
cmd_get_lr_satellite_data.description: Perform LR GNSS scan and return GNSS + satellite data.

cmd_get_ublox_fix.label: get ublox fix
cmd_get_ublox_fix.description: Perform u-blox fix and return position message.

cmd_get_ublox_satellite_data.label: get ublox satellite data
cmd_get_ublox_satellite_data.description: Perform u-blox fix and return position + satellite data.

cmd_join.label: join
cmd_join.description: Start LoRaWAN joining sequence. If already joined, leave and re-join.

cmd_pause_rf_scan.label: pause rf scan
cmd_pause_rf_scan.description: Pause RF scanning. Use payload 0 to pause, 1 to unpause.

cmd_read_all_lr_messages.label: read all lr messages
cmd_read_all_lr_messages.description: Debug only (Bluetooth). Read and remove all queued LoRaWAN thread messages.

cmd_reset_initial_position.label: reset initial position
cmd_reset_initial_position.description: Reset initial reference position to hardcoded value (not recommended).

cmd_reset_initial_time.label: reset initial time
cmd_reset_initial_time.description: Reset initial reference time to hardcoded value (not recommended).

cmd_reset_to_def_settings.label: reset to def settings
cmd_reset_to_def_settings.description: Revert settings to defaults; LoRaWAN keys will be deleted.

cmd_s_band_send.label: s band send
cmd_s_band_send.description: Compose and send an s-band message.

cmd_send_all_settings.label: send all settings
cmd_send_all_settings.description: Return all settings in stacked format. Not supported via LoRa due to payload size.

cmd_send_all_val.label: send all val
cmd_send_all_val.description: Return all values in stacked format. Not recommended via LoRa due to payload size.

cmd_send_bt_cmdq_results.label: send bt cmdq results
cmd_send_bt_cmdq_results.description: Send latest CMDQ scan results (does not start a new scan).

cmd_send_lr_fix.label: send lr fix
cmd_send_lr_fix.description: Obtain LR GNSS message and send via LoRa.

cmd_send_lr_message.label: send lr message
cmd_send_lr_message.description: Send message to device to be sent via LR. Format: data_len data[data_len] (up to 46 bytes).

cmd_send_position.label: send position
cmd_send_position.description: Send last known GPS position (no new fix). Responds with msg_last_position on port 31.

cmd_send_single_setting.label: send single setting
cmd_send_single_setting.description: Get a single setting by id. Format: setting_id setting_length [setting bytes].

cmd_send_single_val.label: send single val
cmd_send_single_val.description: Get a single value by id. Format: value_id value_length [value bytes].

cmd_send_status.label: send status
cmd_send_status.description: Send status message via LoRa/BT to status port 4.

cmd_send_status_lr.label: send status lr
cmd_send_status_lr.description: Send status message via LoRa to status port 4.

cmd_set_hibernation_mode.label: set hibernation mode
cmd_set_hibernation_mode.description: Enter hibernation mode (like reed switch). Only magnet can reboot; BT and LoRaWAN disabled.

cmd_set_location_and_time.label: set location and time
cmd_set_location_and_time.description: Set reference location and time. Payload: lon*1e7 int32, lat*1e7 int32, unix time uint32.

cmd_set_operation_mode_com_th.label: set operation mode com th
cmd_set_operation_mode_com_th.description: Set LoRa/GPS thread mode: 0 disabled, 1 low power, 2 normal.

cmd_set_operation_mode_main_th.label: set operation mode main th
cmd_set_operation_mode_main_th.description: Set main thread mode: 0 disabled, 1 low power, 2 normal (BT advertising off for 0/1).

cmd_single_bt_scan.label: single bt scan
cmd_single_bt_scan.description: Internal: initiate periodic single BT scan between threads.

cmd_recover_sd.label: recover SD card
cmd_recover_sd.description: Ask an offload station to check its SD card now. A healthy station only produces a fresh statistics report (port 23); a station with a failed card runs its recovery test (write, close and read back a test file) and gets ten new reader reset attempts. No reply on success; cmd_confirm 0 when refused (not an active offload station). Firmware 8.2 (beta).
